[SWS_DM_00941] Concurrent ara::diag interface calls for DID read processing
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04166
⌈
The DM shall only call a read
DID
processing method on an interface for service
processing in a concurrent way if it is:
• in default session and
• multiple conversation requests are being processed simultaneously and
